description: The agentic-web daily digest as structured data. Input: date (YYYY-MM-DD, default latest), or list: true for the index of every published date. Returns headline, lede, items (title, body, why_it_matters, kind, related standards, and the sources each item rests on, labelled VERIFIED or REPORTED), the day's measured stats (adoption and grade changes across a fixed panel of domains re-checked daily, fastest-growing repositories, MCP Registry activity) and how it was made. Every number in an item appears in a source it cites. Human version: https://agenticweb.wiki/digest/.

list.description: true: the index of published dates instead of one digest

name: digest
